g.title: Sheet.62
g.desc: - Should I expect only two or more routers in the attached su...
g.text: - Should I expect only two or more routers in the attached subnet?- Should I discover neighbors using multicast or unicast Hello messages?- Should I send LSAs using multicast or unicast?- Should I attempt to elect a DR on that interface?I need to know the network type!

g.title: Sheet.214
g.desc: - The WAN service can be a direct cable, Metro Ethernet, VPLS...
g.text: - The WAN service can be a direct cable, Metro Ethernet, VPLS, a T1/E1 Leased Line, MPLS, Dark Fiber, WiFi, Microwave Link, Frame Relay, ATM, GRE or IPsec tunnel, DMVPN, etc.- Each has different properties.- The OSPF router cannot automatically discover all properties of the WAN.
